signal: Filevine launched LOIS, its Legal Operating Intelligence System with native AI workflows for law firms

email.body1:
Travis, saw Filevine launched LOIS, your Legal Operating Intelligence System with native AI workflows.

Shipping a category move like that usually means more law firms worth a conversation than your team can reach before the buzz fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Travis, quick follow-up for Filevine.

With a new platform to push into the market, most sales leaders can't say how many meetings they actually need to convert that momentum into pipeline, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Travis, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Travis, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Bringing a new AI system to market is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a legal-tech motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
